crossRefs.note: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because…
If it isn’t so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?”
If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.
You are of God, little children, and have overcome them; because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the…
Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and…
for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:

translations.web: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
translations.bsb: If we say we have not sinned, we make Him out to be a liar, and His word is not in us.
translations.kjv: If we say that we have ➔ not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
translations.asv: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
